name: CANADIAN CEDAR INDOOR WET DRY SAUNA STEAM ROOM
description:
Canadian Cedar Indoor Wet Dry Sauna Steam Room for 2 People 

This gorgeous sauna is stylish and functional.  The compact size enables faster heating times.  You no longer have to compromise and can chose between a dry or wet steam sauna. Enjoy the health benefits and relax in your own wet dry sauna at home. Comes with a Free Gift.  This product includes a wooden bucket with scoop and sauna stones.
